aesthetic_direction.mood: Premium athletic, high-performance, tactical minimalism, editorial.
aesthetic_direction.description: Transitioning from brutalist orange/navy to a sleek 'Performance Pro' aesthetic inspired by Ladder. Embracing a near-black canvas, high-contrast crisp white typography, and deliberate editorial serif accents. The UI feels luxurious, focused, and heavy, relying on photography and typography rather than complex UI chrome.

typography.strategy: Editorial Serif + Athletic Sans. Using high contrast in font weights to establish hierarchy without needing color.
typography.body_font: Inter (Clean, highly legible for dense data)

scales.h1: font-size: 48px, line-height: 1.0, tracking: -1px, font-family: Instrument Serif
scales.h2: font-size: 32px, line-height: 1.1, tracking: -0.5px, font-family: Instrument Serif
scales.h3: font-size: 24px, line-height: 1.2, tracking: -0.2px, font-family: Inter, font-weight: 700
scales.label: font-size: 11px, line-height: 1.2, tracking: 1.5px, text-transform: uppercase, font-family: Inter, font-weight: 600
scales.stats: font-size: 64px, line-height: 1.0, tracking: -2px, font-family: Inter, font-weight: 900

visual_enhancers.grain_noise: Use a subtle noise image overlay with low opacity (0.02 - 0.04) across background views to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.depth_shadows: Zero drop shadows. Use 1px inner borders (--border-subtle) on cards to create surface separation.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Strictly for sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, and action sheets. Heavy blur (e.g., BlurView intensity 80-100) with a dark tint (rgba(10,10,10,0.7)).

screen_redesign_specs.name: Trainee Home / Discovery Feed
screen_redesign_specs.layout_rules: Vertical scrolling feed of massive trainer cards (80vh height). Think TikTok or Ladder discovery.
key_elements: Header: Transparent with a blur-backed proximity/location selector pill.
Trainer Cards: Full-bleed imagery with a LinearGradient overlay (transparent at top, rgba(0,0,0,0.9) at bottom).
Typography on Card: Trainer name in H1 Instrument Serif at the bottom left. Price/Personality tags as ultra-minimal glass pills.
Interaction: Paging scroll enabled (snap to card).

screen_redesign_specs.name: Trainer Detail / Profile
screen_redesign_specs.layout_rules: Editorial magazine layout. Sticky booking CTA at the bottom.
key_elements: Hero: Immersive photo that scales up on over-scroll (parallax).
Vibe Player/Highlight Reel: Edge-to-edge horizontal scroll or auto-playing muted video loop.
Bio: Set in H3 Instrument Serif to feel like an editorial quote.
Sticky Action Bar: Glassmorphic footer containing the price and 'Book Session' primary button.

screen_redesign_specs.name: Session Booking Flow
screen_redesign_specs.layout_rules: Step-by-step modal sheet flow. Highly focused, one decision per screen.
key_elements: Date/Time Picker: Large, custom horizontal scrolling date bubbles. No standard generic pickers.
Session Type: Two massive tactile cards for 'Outdoor' vs 'Gym' with high-contrast active states (1px Electric Blaze border + icon).
Price Breakdown: Minimalist receipt style, monospaced font for numbers.

screen_redesign_specs.name: Live Session Tracking
key_elements: Map: Custom dark mode map styling (desaturated roads, vibrant Electric Blaze route line).
Metrics: Oversized, highly legible stats (ETA, Distance) floating in glass panels.
Offline Banner: Redesigned from a standard red block to a subtle striped dark-yellow tactical warning pill at the top.

screen_redesign_specs.name: Trainer Earnings + KYC
key_elements: Earnings Stat: Massive numeric typography (64px).
KYC Status: Elegant status pills (e.g., 1px green border with green text for 'Verified').
Chart: Minimalist sparkline chart (React Native Skia/SVG) with a single vibrant accent line.

screen_redesign_specs.name: Auth (Login/Register)
key_elements: Background: Full-bleed moody gym photography (darkened significantly).
Form: Floating, borderless input fields with subtle bottom-borders that highlight on focus.
Typography: 'Welcome to the club' set in beautiful editorial Serif.

screen_redesign_specs.name: Trainer's Own Profile Edit
key_elements: Avatar: Large circular `<UserAvatar>` component with a 2px offset border.
Inputs: Inline editing where possible. Labels are tiny, uppercase and tracked out.
Tags: Tap-to-add personality tags in a dense, wrapped flex row.

screen_redesign_specs.name: Admin Panel (Web)
screen_redesign_specs.layout_rules: Dense, analytical, edge-to-edge layout. High density grid (Mode B).
key_elements: Sidebar: Dark navy/black monochrome.
Tables: Cardless. Data tables sit directly on the background with subtle 1px border bottoms for rows.
Typography: Strict adherence to Inter font. No serifs here.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (borderRadius: 999px). backgroundColor: var(--accent-primary), text-color: #FFF. Font: bold, 16px. No shadows.
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped. backgroundColor: transparent. borderWidth: 1px, borderColor: var(--border-strong). text-color: #FFF.
buttons.ghost: No background, no border. text-color: var(--text-secondary). text-decoration: underline (optional).
buttons.destructive: backgroundColor: #2A0808, borderWidth: 1px, borderColor: var(--error). text-color: var(--error).
buttons.motion: On press, opacity drops to 0.7 or scale shrinks slightly (0.97) using React Native Reanimated.

cards.trainer_card: Vertical rectangle. borderRadius: 16px. overflow: hidden. Background is entirely an <Image> with a LinearGradient overlay at the bottom 40%.
cards.stat_card: backgroundColor: var(--bg-card), borderRadius: 12px, borderWidth: 1px, borderColor: var(--border-subtle). padding: 24px.

inputs.default: backgroundColor: var(--bg-surface), borderRadius: 8px, padding: 16px, color: #FFF. Placeholder color: var(--text-tertiary).

bottom_sheet.handle: width: 40px, height: 4px, borderRadius: 2px, backgroundColor: var(--border-strong), alignSelf: center, marginTop: 12px.

bottom_tab_bar.style: BlurView background. absolute positioning at bottom. borderTopWidth: 1px, borderTopColor: var(--border-subtle).
bottom_tab_bar.icons: Lucide-react-native icons. Active: var(--text-primary). Inactive: var(--text-tertiary).

motion_interaction.page_transitions: Native iOS standard push/pop (provided by Expo Router). Do not over-engineer.
motion_interaction.hero_parallax: On Trainer Detail scroll down, use Reanimated `interpolate` to scale the hero image up.
motion_interaction.press_feedback: Use native TouchableOpacity or Pressable with Reanimated scale spring (0.95 down, 1.0 up) on cards.
motion_interaction.stagger_reveals: For lists (e.g., Trainee Home feed), use a subtle fade-up stagger on mount (Y translation from 20px to 0, opacity 0 to 1).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text over images always has a gradient underlay meeting 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44 points for all interactive elements (buttons, toggles, tags).
accessibility.voice_over: Apply `accessibilityLabel` to all `<Image>` and icon buttons. Apply `accessibilityRole="button"` explicitly.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `testID` attribute (e.g., `testID="book-session-button"`).

migration_plan.step_1: Typography Swap: Integrate `Instrument Serif` and `Inter` via `expo-font`. Replace all generic system fonts in headings globally. (Impact: Huge, Effort: Low)
migration_plan.step_2: Color Overhaul: Update global context/theme file from Brutalist Orange/Navy to the Performance Pro Dark theme. Change app background to `#0A0A0A`.
migration_plan.step_3: Component Restyle: Update the core Button and Card primitives to remove drop shadows and apply the new pill/border logic.
migration_plan.step_4: Screen Specifics: Redesign the Trainee Home feed to use full-bleed vertical cards instead of standard lists.

image_urls.description: Powerful, moody shot of a trainer in a dark studio. Perfect for the hero profile image.
Desaturated, athletic lifestyle portrait. Excellent for feed cards.
Dark and atmospheric gym interior. Use for session booking location previews or auth backgrounds.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use generic AI-slop patterns (e.g., purple gradients, centered arbitrary boxes).
Always rely on high-contrast, tactical minimalism (deep blacks, crisp whites).
Every button and pressable element must have a `testID` attribute in React Native for testing.
Do NOT use pure transparency (`rgba(0,0,0,0)`) on elements that sit above scrolling content; always use a BlurView or solid color.
Respect native platform paradigms while pushing the editorial visual style. The UX should feel instantly familiar to iOS/Android users.
DO NOT output HTML/divs in the React Native codebase. Use View, Text, Pressable, Image.
When modifying styling in React Native, use `StyleSheet.create` or inline styles consistently as per the existing codebase architecture.
